## Registry Submission

Thank you for contributing to the RJ Nexus registry.

> **Faster option:** use the web form at https://rj-nexus.github.io/rj-registration/ — a bot will open this Pull Request for you.

---

### What does this PR add or change?

- [ ] New theme
- [ ] New plugin
- [ ] Update existing entry (category, tags, logo, screenshots)
- [ ] Update repository URL
- [ ] Remove entry

---

### Package information

- **Name:**
- **Repository:** `owner/repo`
- **Type:** theme / plugin
- **Version:**
- **Category:**
- **License:** MIT / GPL / Apache / BSD / other

---

### Checklist

- [ ] I edited `themes.json` or `plugins.json` (not `registry.json` directly)
- [ ] I updated `count` and `updated_at` in `registry.json`
- [ ] The repository is public and accessible
- [ ] `theme.json` or `plugin.json` exists at the repository root
- [ ] The manifest `name` matches the entry `name`
- [ ] There is at least one GitHub Release with a ZIP asset
- [ ] Logo and screenshots are direct `https://` URLs
- [ ] `verified` and `featured` are set to `false`
- [ ] Tags are lowercase and hyphen-separated (max 8)
- [ ] No duplicate entry — this repository is not already in the registry

---

### Additional notes

Add anything else maintainers should know: screenshots, demo links, changelog highlights, or context for review.
